title: test(hits): first pass at widgets testing
body:
@redox, here's how I did it.

I removed the pre-bound Template component because it in fact
complexifies a lot testing and is not more easy to understand than

comments.body:
cc @algolia/javascript what do you think? I propose a new way to pass templateProps down the line.

The previous version is fun but really hard to test because it requires more and more mocking while not providing a code that is easier to understand.
Ok I have updated the PR @redox with even more separation. Have a look for your own tests.
Oh thanks. The prebound template was really hard to grasp and ugly
